title: Quant and trading firms
note: community repos: hundreds of companies incl. bespoke boards (Jane Street, Google, Meta, Apple, banks). JSON repos use the Simplify listings format; markdown repos are parsed via github_md with per-repo column maps (cols = 0-based indexes).

citadel._note: in-house ATS (careers.citadel.com), no public API — aggregator repos below cover it

citadel_sec._note: in-house ATS (careers.citadelsecurities.com), no public API — aggregator repos below cover it

sig._note: careers.sig.com runs on iCIMS; its listing pages carry a description snippet but no location or posting date

two_sigma._note: in-house ATS (careers.twosigma.com), no public API — aggregator repos below cover it

gts._note: in-house ATS (gtsx.com/careers), no public API — aggregator repos below cover it

jane_street._note: their own positions JSON — direct, includes salary + New Grad/Internship availability

nwfintech_quant27._note: quant repo but |Role|Links| format has no company column (company only in URL) — cryptic role abbrevs; disabled until a cleaner parse path
